name: Switch
description: N-way branch based on a value. Resolves the input once, walks cases in order, emits the matched case's name as a string. Downstream filters route on it (e.g. a string-filter equals 'gold' on the switch's output). Pair with a default case for the catch-all.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: The value to switch on — typically a path into the request or a context key.

params.name: cases
params.description: Ordered list of cases. Each entry is { match: <json-value>, name: <case-name> }. The first case whose `match` equals the input wins; the engine emits the case's `name` as the node output.

params.name: default
params.description: Case name to emit when no case matches. Omit to throw on unmatched (strict mode).

outputs.name: out
outputs.description: Emits the matched case's name. Wire into downstream string-filter equals nodes to route by case.
